newsitem.title: ITALY: Benetton sells sport eyewear to Bausch.
newsitem.headline: Benetton sells sport eyewear to Bausch.

text.p: Italy's Benetton Sportsystem said in a statement it had sold its Killer Loop sports eyewear business to Bausch & Lomb Inc of Rochester (New York).

Bausch & Lomb, which was Benetton's sole distribution agent for the sports sunglasses worlwide, becomes 100 percent owner of the Killer Loop eyewear business including its trademark and design and development facility at Pederobba, Italy.

Benetton Sportsystem keeps its interest in Killer Loop clothing, accessories and sporting goods like snowboards, it said, adding: "Together these account for approximately 60 percent of the total turnover...(of) in excess of 100 billion lire."
"We have chosen to concentrate on what we do best: street apparel, sportswear and sporting goods," Gilberto Benetton, chairman of Benetton Sportsystem said.

"Forecasts show these are the market sectors offering the greatest scope for development. We will continue to design, manufacture and market our Killer Loop apparel and sporting goods and we will expand these businesses," he said.

The Benetton statement also quoted Jeff Pontius, manager of Bausch & Lomb's global business eyewear division, as saying the purchase ensured the company maintained a "proven market place winner in our comprehensive portfolio eyewear of premium sunglasses."
